channel.title: Noty
channel.description: Sticky notes that live at the edge of your screen.

item.description:
Noty 1.3.0

  • Arm the hot-key repeat window on close as well as open
  • One hot-key press is one toggle, however long it is held
  • Quick capture no longer activates the app
  • Quick capture and the noty:// URL scheme
  • Preview card strikes done tasks in the note's ink
  • Release 1.2.1: update appcast
